column3: MT 59:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the rest of the title in parentheses; NASB supplies “men.” “Set me on high” is rendered “Set me securely on high.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they stir up strife against me” is rendered “launch an attack against me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they growl” is rendered “they howl.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “they say.”
“His strength, I will watch for You” is rendered “Because of his strength I will watch for You,” and “my refuge” as “my stronghold.”
“The God of my covenant loyalty” is rendered “My God in His lovingkindness,” and NASB supplies “triumphantly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make them wander” is rendered “Scatter them.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “On account of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they growl” is rendered “they howl.”
“And they spent the night” (or “murmured”) is rendered “And growl.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a refuge” is rendered “my stronghold.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the God of my covenant loyalty” is rendered “the God who shows me lovingkindness.”
